us-west-tx-p4-nuai-pr-2026-08-14-tcdc-pe.summary: Release datelined Midland, Texas, 14 August 2026: construction permits for Texas Critical Data Centers LLC ('TCDC') are 'now in hand'. Listed highlights: received Development Structure and Drive Approach Permits from Ector County; submitted the Phase 1 plat to Ector County and the City of Odessa; received approval of a Notice of Intent with the TCEQ to commence grading and 'intend to begin site grading in the coming weeks'; closed the 54-acre corridor acquisition, so the campus 'now stands at 493 acres'; removed 22 abandoned pipelines across 12 rights-of-way; a final surface waiver is pending from one leasehold operator. New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: NUAI) says its subsidiary TCDC PowerCo LLC has entered a 20-year power purchase agreement with Luminant ET Services Company LLC, an affiliate of Vistra Corp., to supply a minimum of 200 MW and up to 207 MW of power for Phase 1 of New Era's Texas Critical Data Center ('TCDC') project from Vistra's 1,180 MW natural gas-fired generating facility in Odessa, Texas, 'which is located immediately adjacent to the TCDC site'; the power is expected to be available to TCDC in Q3 2027. A companion development framework gives Vistra a 5% non-voting interest in the powered portion after delivery begins and rights of first refusal/offer on future power development.
